income.title.description: Heading of the section of the income from the supporter plans on the finances page, the public page of the running costs, and the costs screen.

income.public.no_balance.defaultMessage: このサーバーは費用を公開していないため、収支は公開していません。
income.public.no_balance.description: Note in the income section of the public page of the running costs when the server publishes its income but not its costs, so the balance is not published.

income.loading.defaultMessage: 収入を読み込んでいます
income.loading.description: Accessible name of the progress indicator while the income totals load.

income.failed.defaultMessage: 収入を読み込めませんでした
income.failed.description: Heading shown in place of the income totals when they could not be loaded.

income.retry.description: Button that tries again to load the income totals after a failure.

income.totals.caption.description: Accessible caption of the table of the income totals: the chosen period kind and the way payments are counted.

income.totals.gross.description: Column header and term of what the supporters paid before the payment provider's fees, on the costs screen only.

income.totals.fee.description: Column header and term of the payment provider's fees, on the costs screen only.

income.totals.net.description: Column header and term of the income after the payment provider's fees and the refunds.

income.totals.balance.description: Column header of the balance: the income less the costs of the same period and currency.

income.plans.title.description: Heading of the number of members of each supporter plan now, next to the income totals.

income.plans.description.defaultMessage: いまの加入者の数で、期間ごとの数ではありません。プランごとの金額は出しません。
income.plans.description.description: Explanation of the number of members of each supporter plan next to the income totals.

income.plans.empty.defaultMessage: 加入者のいるプランはありません。
income.plans.empty.description: What the list of the members of each plan says when no plan has members.

income.plans.members.description: The number of members of a supporter plan now.

income.rules.title.description: Heading of the rules that date and place the payments in the income totals.

income.rules.net.defaultMessage: 収入は、サポーターが払った額から決済の事業者の手数料を引いたものです。返金とチャージバックは、それが起きた期間で差し引きます。
income.rules.net.description: Rule of the income totals: what the income is.

income.rules.provider.defaultMessage: {provider} の支払いは {timeZone} のタイムゾーンの日付で数えます。
income.rules.provider.description: Rule of the income totals: the time zone in which a payment provider (such as stripe) dates its money movements (UTC, Asia/Tokyo).

income.rules.amortized.defaultMessage: {days} 日より長い期間の支払い (年払いなど) は、支払った期間の日数に日割りで載せます。その返金は、返金の日までの分を返金の日にまとめて差し引き、それより後の日の分を打ち消します。ほかの支払いはその日付に載せます。
income.rules.amortized.description: Rule of the spread income totals. {days} is the number of days a payment must cover to be spread, such as 31.

income.rules.cash.defaultMessage: 支払い・返金・手数料は、それぞれの日付に載せます。
income.rules.cash.description: Rule of the income totals on the payment date.

income.rules.balance.defaultMessage: 収支は、通貨ごとに、同じ数え方の収入から費用を引いたものです。通貨は換算しません。
income.rules.balance.description: Rule of the income totals: what the balance is.
